comment: Optional destructible-arena mode (docs/DESTRUCTIBLE.md), M1 'all maps'. A Godot-side CONFIG overlay: it does not author props. On every supported arena map the mode analyses the map's own cover boxes (from maps.json geometry.boxes), throws away floor/ground, boundary walls, stairs, ladder/pad/spawn-adjacent and structural geometry, then picks about half of the remaining cover with a per-match seed. The pick is WEIGHTED by how usable/visible the cover is: close to the map's play centre, free-standing (open sides), visible from the surrounding floor, at fighter height. fraction = share of eligible cover components made breakable; budget.perMap = hard cap per arena (40 default, 60 max). hp scales with component volume: min for a small crate, max for a big block. respawn min/max are seconds (randomised per break, so breaks do not come back metronomically); fadeSeconds is the materialise fade-in; retrySeconds postpones a respawn while a fighter stands in the box. colors.accent is the bright accent frame + body tint, a colour deliberately unlike the map palettes so a breakable is obvious (the arena's own crates are already yellow/orange); tint mixes it into the body colour, rubble is how much the rubble patch darkens the body colour. selection holds the safety rules (spawn/ladder/pad clearances, the ring-out edge margin, the box-size band that separates cover from floors, roofs, stairs and decorative slivers) plus the usability weights of the weighted pick.
